She wins a prize if at least two of her numbers match two of the randomly drawn numbers. She wins the grand prize if all four of her numbers match the four drawn numbers. The question is asking for the probability that she wins the grand prize given that she won a prize, and express this as a reduced fraction m/n, then find m + n.

In this case, event A is winning the grand prize, and event B is winning a prize (i.e., at least two numbers match). So the question wants P(A|B), which is P(A and B)/P(B).
